about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Norwegian Sour Cream Porridge Rommegrot
recipes.summary: A rich, silky porridge simmered from sour cream, flour and milk, served with cinnamon and sugar.
steps: Simmer the sour cream in a heavy saucepan for 5 minutes until it thins and the fat starts to separate.
Sift in the flour, whisking, and cook for 3 minutes until smooth and thick.
Add the milk gradually, whisking, and simmer for 8 minutes until thick and glossy.
Stir in the butter and serve topped with the sugar and cinnamon.
notes: Traditionally the separated butter is skimmed off and drizzled on top.

recipes.title: Estonian Cucumber and Sour Cream Salad
recipes.summary: Cool cucumber slices dressed with sour cream, dill and a splash of vinegar.
steps: Whisk the sour cream, dill, vinegar, sugar and salt together until smooth.
Fold the cucumber through the dressing until coated.
Serve straight away with potatoes or grilled fish.
notes: Salt draws water from the cucumber, so dress it just before serving.

recipes.title: Portuguese Chickpea and Egg Salad
recipes.summary: Chickpeas, boiled egg and red onion in olive oil and parsley, a classic Portuguese petisco.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until the yolks are firm, then cool, peel and chop.
Combine the chickpeas, onion and parsley in a bowl.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and salt, toss through the salad and fold in the egg.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the yolks are firm and keep the salad chilled, eating within 2 days.

recipes.title: Spanish Orange and Red Onion Salad
recipes.summary: Juicy orange rounds with red onion, black olives and olive oil, a bright Andalusian winter salad.
steps: Arrange the orange slices on a platter and scatter over the onion and olives.
Whisk the oil and vinegar together.
Drizzle over the salad until the slices glisten, then finish with the parsley.
notes: Soak the onion in cold water first for a milder bite.

recipes.title: Spanish Garlic Mushrooms Champinones al Ajillo
recipes.summary: Mushrooms sizzled in olive oil with lots of garlic, chilli and lemon, a tapas bar favourite.
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook the mushrooms for 6 minutes until golden and their liquid has gone.
Add the garlic and chilli and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Take off the heat and stir through the lemon juice, parsley and salt.
notes: Serve with crusty bread to mop up the oil.

recipes.title: Galician Paprika Potatoes
recipes.summary: Boiled potatoes tossed in olive oil, sweet smoked paprika and coarse salt.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes until tender, then drain and let them steam dry for 2 minutes.
Toss with the oil, paprika and salt until evenly coated.
Serve warm straight from the bowl, with extra paprika on the side if you like.
notes: Use a mix of sweet and hot paprika for extra warmth.

recipes.title: Peruvian Corn, Tomato and Feta Salad
recipes.summary: Sweet corn kernels, tomato and salty feta with lime and coriander, like the Andean solterito.
steps: Boil the corn for 10 to 12 minutes until tender, then cool and cut the kernels from the cobs.
Combine the kernels, tomato, onion and feta in a bowl.
Dress with the oil and lime juice and scatter with the coriander.
notes: Serve with grilled meat or fish.

recipes.title: Ecuadorian Peanut Sauce for Potatoes
recipes.summary: A warm, creamy peanut and onion sauce for boiled potatoes, eggs and grilled meat.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Whisk in the peanut butter, milk and salt and simmer for 4 minutes, stirring, until thick and smooth.
Spoon over potatoes or grilled meat.
notes: Thin with extra milk if it thickens on standing.

recipes.title: Smoky Paprika Aioli for Grilled Fish
recipes.summary: Garlicky mayonnaise with smoked paprika and lemon, a spoonful for grilled fish and prawns.
steps: Mix the mayonnaise, garlic, paprika and lemon juice together in a bowl.
Stir until smooth, then taste and adjust the lemon and paprika.
Spoon beside grilled fish or prawns.

recipes.title: Green Chilli and Coriander Chutney for Grilled Meat
recipes.summary: A fiery, fresh herb chutney with yoghurt and lime for kebabs and tandoori-style meats.
steps: Blend the coriander, mint, chillies, garlic, lemon juice, oil and salt until smooth.
Stir through the yoghurt until evenly green.
Spoon beside grilled meat.

recipes.title: Hoisin Barbecue Glaze
recipes.summary: A sticky hoisin, honey and soy glaze with five spice for ribs, chicken and pork belly.
steps: Combine all the ingredients in a small pan.
Simmer for 4 minutes, stirring, until thick and glossy.
Brush over meat during the last 10 minutes of grilling.
notes: Food safety: do not reuse glaze that touched raw meat unless you boil it for 2 minutes first.
Not suitable for gluten-free unless you use tamari.

recipes.title: Ginger Soy Dressing for Steamed Greens
recipes.summary: A quick dressing of soy, ginger, sesame oil and garlic to spoon over bok choy and broccoli.
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, ginger, honey and garlic together until combined.
Whisk in the sesame oil and vegetable oil until glossy.
Spoon over steamed greens.
notes: Not suitable for gluten-free unless you use tamari.

recipes.title: Seeded Crunch Topping
recipes.summary: Toasted sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds with honey, for porridge, yoghurt and salads.
steps: Toast the sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds in a dry pan for 4 minutes until golden.
Add the honey and salt and stir for 2 minutes until the seeds clump and the honey turns sticky.
Spread on baking paper and cool until crisp, then break into pieces.

recipes.title: Egyptian Eggah Herb Omelette
recipes.summary: A thick, sliceable omelette packed with parsley, dill and spring onion.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the flour, cumin and salt, then stir in the parsley, dill and spring onions.
Heat the oil in a 24 cm non-stick frying pan and pour in the mixture.
Cook over low heat for 10 minutes until the base is golden and the top is nearly set, then grill for 3 minutes until set.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set with no runny egg.

recipes.title: Malawian Peanut Butter Maize Porridge
recipes.summary: Thick maize porridge enriched with peanut butter and a spoon of sugar.
steps: Whisk the maize flour with 1/2 cup of the cold water until smooth.
Bring the remaining water to the boil and whisk in the paste until smooth.
Simmer for 8 minutes, stirring, until thick, then stir in the peanut butter and sugar.

recipes.title: Tongan Cucumber and Coconut Lime Salad
recipes.summary: Crisp cucumber and tomato in a creamy lime and coconut dressing with chilli.
steps: Combine the cucumber, tomato and chilli in a bowl.
Whisk the coconut cream, lime juice and salt together.
Toss the dressing through the salad until coated.
notes: Serve straight away to keep the cucumber crisp.

recipes.title: Coriander and Lime Dressing for Fish Tacos
recipes.summary: A zesty blended dressing of coriander, lime, garlic and olive oil for fish, slaw and tacos.
steps: Blend the coriander, lime juice, oil, garlic, honey, cumin and salt until smooth.
Taste and add more lime if needed.
Drizzle over fish, slaw or tacos.

recipes.title: Irish Brown Bread with Smoked Salmon and Cucumber
recipes.summary: Wholemeal brown bread layered with cream cheese, smoked salmon, cucumber and lemon.
steps: Spread the cream cheese over the brown bread until it reaches the edges.
Top with the cucumber and smoked salmon.
Finish with the lemon juice and dill, then cut into triangles.
notes: Food safety: smoked salmon is eaten uncooked, so keep it chilled and avoid it in pregnancy.

recipes.title: Savoury Mushroom and Barley Breakfast Porridge
recipes.summary: Pearl barley simmered in mushroom stock, soy and spring onion, a warming savoury start.
steps: Cook the onion and mushrooms in the oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the barley, stock and soy sauce and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until the barley is tender and the porridge is thick.
Ladle into bowls and top with the spring onions.
notes: Add a poached egg for extra protein.

recipes.title: Carrot and Cumin Soup with Yoghurt
recipes.summary: A sweet, earthy carrot soup spiced with cumin and swirled with yoghurt.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the cumin for 1 minute.
Add the carrots and stock and simmer for 20 minutes until very tender.
Blend until smooth and serve with a swirl of yoghurt.
notes: Check the stock label for gluten.
Use a dairy-free yoghurt to make it vegan.

recipes.title: Lemon Tahini Dressing
recipes.summary: A creamy sesame dressing sharpened with lemon and garlic for grain bowls and roast vegetables.
steps: Whisk the tahini and lemon juice together until thick, which will look curdled at first.
Whisk in the garlic, salt and water until smooth and pourable.
Drizzle over salads or vegetables from the oven.
